comment: PROVENANCE (jsntrs-qr9): this group's 55 `token` values were derived in wave 5 from jsonata 2.2.2 and re-probed here — all 55 are byte-identical to what that engine attaches. The documentation specifies error CODES and never says an error carries a token at all (docs/behaviors.md 2.0.1), so `tests/conformance.rs` reports a token difference instead of failing on one and no NEW token expectation may be added. The `code` is the enforced part. UNRESOLVED: this token names the combining operator, not the construct that raised the error. jsonata 2.2.2 `evaluateBinary` wraps the whole of `and`/`or` — including the deferred right operand — in a try whose catch assigns `err.token = op` unconditionally (jsonata.js:3917-3924), so the operand's own attribution is overwritten; jsntrs reproduces that in `evaluator/binary.rs::with_op_token`. The documentation gives no rule to re-derive it from, so the value is left pinned WITH this note rather than guessed at or dropped.
